A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we introduce a novel vision Transformer, namely GVT, which is able to model long-range interactions in both spatial and channel dimensions, and is able to achieve competitive performance with a compact model size.
we propose a Glance-and-Gaze (GnG) Transformer, which can effectively reduce the quadratic complexity of self-attention to linear complexity with respect to the sequence length.
, we propose the G3Net, a novel vision transformer that is capable of handling high resolution images and generating high-quality dense predictions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for dense prediction tasks, the quadratic computational complexity of vision Transformer is unnecessary and can be reduced to a linear one.
, by carefully designing the attention mechanism and the architecture, we can build a vision Transformer that is efficient enough to handle dense predictions on high-resolution images.
, by leveraging the fact that the spatial location information in the high-resolution feature maps is highly redundant, we can significantly reduce the computation cost of vision Transformers.
